about:
Nissha Medical Technologies operates a facility in Sandpoint, Idaho, as part of its global contract manufacturing network for medical devices. The company's global headquarters is in Buffalo, New York. No founding year or ownership details are disclosed in the available sources.

The Sandpoint site contributes to Nissha's vertically integrated capabilities, which span product design and development, micro molding, automated assembly, metal machining and fabrication, complex cable assembly, and specialty packaging. The company emphasizes submicron tool building and high-resolution CT scanning to validate micro features. Its manufacturing footprint extends across North America, Europe, Asia, and the Caribbean, offering manual, semi-automated, and fully automated production. Specific facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not published.

Nissha serves medical device OEMs across three core specializations: clinical wearables, minimally invasive surgical devices, and micro molding with automated assembly. Its customer base includes companies developing drug delivery devices, surgical navigation systems, surgical robotics, endoscopes, and sensor-integrated instruments.

The company differentiates itself through accelerator programs — Clinical Wearables Lab, Design for Excellence (DFX), and AGILE Production Planning — that compress development timelines through on-site, cross-functional collaboration. It also cites its position as the largest medical-focused micro molder in the United States and its ISO 13485 certification with EU MDR compliance as quality foundations.
